display_name: LoRa W24 跨 chirp 方向的条件式正式 Full 测试
description: Fixed 30,000 physical-packet Full evaluation automatically gated by independently scored frozen source qualification.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and Full-only CPU-ready truth-last evaluation.

code.environment: N607 CPU FP32 W24 archive, at most one prediction shard worker with two intraop threads and two replay workers; local independent CPU scorer.
code.cwd: Immutable formal release controller then original W24 archive for prediction workers.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: Frozen matched 15 target receivers x 2000 physical IDs in the registered native Full test order; 300 source V only for independent qualification.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Registered LoRa source/target contract with independent source seed, namespace and packets.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Source qualification before any target IQ open, fixed E104 receiver-only inputs, independent local target truth-last joining after all 3 prediction shards close.

checkpoint.initialization: No adjustment. Use terminal Peer Spectral trained at 48,000 source updates, frozen Practical half and prior 24,000-step direction; E104 unchanged.

sources.role: Independent source qualification and terminal 48000-step shared within/cross-chirp direction checkpoint.
Frozen original fixed-dose direction, matched actual comparison.
Frozen source-only native Practical exact-additive base for all three new readouts.
Immutable blind direct, old DURA half, complex-response half and wide all-packet half controls, same physical packets.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Registered source U and physical IDs for scratch fitting. All comparison checkpoints and frozen E104 opened only for post-freeze comparison.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Reuse matching source contract and source-eligible terminal freeze. No target or W24 fitting.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Same parent registered source promotion with independent truth-last; early F/IQ target evaluation forbidden.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU-only. Wait only for independent source qualification. Then sequentially execute three fixed native Full shards without GPU wait.
execution.stop_rule: Negative source qualification terminates this conditional run before target access. For qualified runs stop for contract/real source smoke/artifact/scoring technical failure; preserve results and unrelated tasks.

expected_artifacts: independent scores/scores.json if all shards frozen

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: w24_peer_formal_collect; independent local truth-last after all 3 frozen receipts.

rows.method: Conditional Full with frozen E104 and fixed learned within and cross chirp ablations
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.budget_ref: 3 independent 10,000 packet prediction shards. Same E104 and seven scenes; no fit.
expected_artifacts: independent scores/scores.json if all shards frozen

notes: Formal acceptance is >=162000/180000 six practical, >=25500/30000 low urban and >=28566/30000 clean.
